name: job-ticket
title: Laundry job ticket
for_each: select id,ticket from orders where status not in ('collected','cancelled')

sections.title: Garment count and care
sections.sql: select tag,description,care_label,condition_in,stage,rack,checked_by from garments where order_id=$1 order by tag
sections.note: Confirm count and care instructions before production. This is not a payment receipt or tax invoice.

sections.title: Identification
sections.sql: select g.tag,o.ticket,g.description,g.care_label,o.due_on,g.rack from garments g join orders o on o.id=g.order_id where g.id=$1
sections.note: Plain text tag. Check your label stock and printer before operational use.

sections.title: Run
sections.sql: select name,run_on,driver from runs where id=$1

sections.title: Stops
sections.sql: select v.sequence,v.kind,v.ticket,v.customer,v.address,v.pieces,v.warning,v.balance_cents,v.currency from v_run_manifest v join stops st on st.id=v.id where st.run_id=$1 order by v.sequence
sections.note: Confirm readiness before dispatch. Balances are recorded amounts, not payment requests.

sections.title: Issue and response
sections.sql: select o.ticket,c.name as customer,cl.issue,cl.opened_on,cl.follow_up_on,cl.status,cl.remedy,cl.resolved_on from claims cl join orders o on o.id=cl.order_id join customers c on c.id=o.customer_id where cl.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded substances
sections.sql: select name,location,max_quantity,hazard_class,sds_reference,sds_review_on from substances where store_id=$1 order by name
sections.note: Verify actual holdings, classifications, maximum quantities and emergency access. This register is not a site safety assessment.
